svg.title: K-medoids clusters
svg.desc: Cluster medoids of 3 clusters from k-medoids, where each cluster is represented by one real training row, over 4 variables. The size bar is the share of training rows in each cluster. Each cell is the medoid value on the standardised scale, restated as a z-score across the clusters so that variables on different scales compare.
